compiled_state.title: Code Review Decision Gate: Hallucination Detection and Approach Viability Assessment
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: Add a decision gate to the code review process that evaluates review feedback along two critical dimensions before acting on it: 1. **Hallucination Detection:** Is the review feedback factually correct? Does it reference real code, real behavior, and real issues — or is the reviewer hallucinating? If feedback is determined to be a hallucination, escalate to a better model and retry the review. 2. **Approach Viability Assessment:** Does the feedback indicate a minor adjustment is needed, or does it reveal that the implementation approach is fundamentally flawed? When feedback signals a flawed approach:    - Document the failed approach with the specific reason it failed    - Revert the code    - Retry implementation from scratch (escalating to a better model if available) This gate sits between receiving review feedback and acting on it, preventing wasted cycles on hallucinated feedback and preventing incremental patches to fundamentally broken approaches.
